ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark-grey) pixels (~85%) with high-intensity (white/light-grey) pixels (~15%) occurring in localized clusters and specular highlights.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity specular reflection blobs on the mid-lateral surface of the left lobe; low-density, high-contrast greyish mottling blobs localized on the medial region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with a pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees and a distinct vertical depth relative to the lobe peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the distal trailing edges; a significant irregular macro-indentation is present on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex primary sweep along the superior margins of both lobes, transitioning to sharp, jagged distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed yellowish-white high-contrast pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant irregular notch or jagged segment missing from the trailing edge of the left lobe medial to the apex.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced yellowish-brown biological encrustations localized specifically at the terminal points of the fluke lobes.
